{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:OhalAlond-AcolyteVG.png]] |name=Ohal Alond |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Listen3|OhalAlond-LostFound.flac|Ohal Alond grunting in pain|Ohal Alond grunts in pain as Mae-ho Aniseya knocks him to the floor and kicks him in the face}} '''Ohal Alond''' was a [[repulsor-barge]] [[captain]] and seasoned [[pazaak]] player active during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], he [[Diet|dined]] with [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] and three other locals in the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]] on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]]. When the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] approached the group and demanded that Indara [[Mae's quest|attack]] her, the [[Jedi]] declined, so Aniseya kicked Alond's stool out from under him and [[Unarmed combat|kicked]] him in the face. After defeating the other diners, the [[assassin]] [[Indara's murder|killed]] Indara. ==Biography== {{Quote|Master Indara.''"
"''Yes, my child?''"
"''We have unfinished business. Attack me with all your strength.''"
[Alond and others laugh]|quoteend=0|Mae-ho Aniseya confronts Indara|audio=Mae-Indara-AttackMe-LostFound.flac|{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}}} [[File:Alond-Indara-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Indara sits between Ohal Alond and Dyn Pigla at a table in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop as Mae-ho Aniseya confronts her.|Ohal Alond dined with Indara at the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop.]] Ohal Alond was a [[human]] who worked as a [[repulsor-barge]] [[captain]] on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. He ferried goods to and from the planet's [[capital]] [[city]], [[Point Ueda]], where he was a local, and set aside a portion of his [[Currency|earnings]] for [[gambling]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Alond had an injury to his left [[Limb|shoulder]] that limited his motion but joined the [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] and fellow locals [[Lobereki]], [[Dyn Pilga]], and [[Tianris Mez]] for a [[Foodstuff|meal]] at the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in Point Ueda. The group sat at a table in the back corner{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{AD|Disney+}} where the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] approached them as they [[Diet|ate]]. She addressed Indara and claimed that the two of them had unfinished business, lowering herself into a fighting stance and [[Mae's quest|demanding]] the [[Jedi]] attack her. The diners were silent for a moment before Mez began laughing and was quickly joined by Alond and the other locals. Indara silenced them with a hand wave and declined to fight Aniseya, claiming Jedi did not fight the unarmed. Angered, Aniseya claimed this was untrue and kicked Alond's stool from beneath him. [[File:AlondFloored-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Ohal Alond, his faced screwed up in pain, lies on the dirt floor of the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop, the foot of Mae-ho Aniseya visible beside him.|Mae-ho Aniseya knocked Ohal Alond to the floor and kicked him in the face.]] Knocked flat to the dirt floor, Alond tried to rise, but Aniseya [[Unarmed combat|stamped down]] on his face and incapacitated him. Alond's friend Mez tried to intervene, but she knocked him out as well and soon defeated Lobereki and Pilga. Indara engaged the [[assassin]], but Aniseya [[Indara's murder|killed]] the Jedi after a lengthy fight. Aniseya left, and the [[Jedi Order]] soon investigated the incident. ==Personality and traits== Alond was a shrewd negotiator. He had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]]. ==Skills and abilities== Alond was a seasoned [[pazaak]] player. ==Equipment== At the [[noodle]] shop, Alond wore a tan [[Clothing|tunic]] over a red hooded shirt with a black and red patterned [[belt]], brown pants, tan shoes, and black [[glove]]s. ==Behind the scenes== Ohal Alond first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} The scenes in the shop were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} Prior to the release of the episode, Alond was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} He was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances==
